chunks.title: Writ: AI writing assistant
chunks.text: Daivik's project Writ: AI writing assistant: A live editor that underlines grammar issues as you type. Spelling and style rules run in a Web Worker, and only the changed paragraph goes to the LLM. A RAG pipeline with local embeddings and Upstash Vector + Redis caching, so every suggestion follows the user's own style guide. Streamed selection rewrites (formal, concise, simplify) and version-checked autosave that never overwrites newer text. Benchmarked on CoNLL-2014 at 0.70 GLEU. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Upstash Vector, Groq, Redis.

chunks.title: Bug-prone file predictor
chunks.text: Daivik's project Bug-prone file predictor: Mines 19 metrics (structural, readability, developer activity) from Git history. A genetic algorithm picks the feature subset, and an Optuna-tuned PyTorch network predicts future bug-fix activity. Evaluated on 1,050 files across Flask, Requests and FastAPI. On FastAPI: 55.6% fewer features and 17.4% lower MSE than the all-features baseline (Wilcoxon test). Stack: Python, PyTorch, Optuna, FastAPI.

chunks.title: Order matching engine
chunks.text: Daivik's project Order matching engine: A deterministic C++17 limit order book with price-time priority, limit/market orders, IOC/FOK, modify and cancel-by-ID. Integer-tick prices and a strictly increasing sequence number on every event, for replayable output. 60+ GoogleTest tests run under ASan/UBSan in CI. Benchmarked at ~139,000 orders/s on 500,000 orders. Stack: C++17, CMake.
